name: Переименовать элементы категории по шаблону
description: Переименовать (задать Mark) всем элементам указанной категории на уровне по шаблону нумерации
code_template:
import clr
clr.AddReference('RevitAPI')
from Autodesk.Revit.DB import *

collector = FilteredElementCollector(doc).OfCategory(BuiltInCategory.OST_{category}).WhereElementIsNotElementType()
elements = [e for e in collector if e.LookupParameter('Level') and e.LookupParameter('Level').AsValueString() == '{level}']

with Transaction(doc, 'Rename elements') as t:
    t.Start()
    for n, elem in enumerate(elements, 1):
        mark = elem.get_Parameter(BuiltInParameter.ALL_MODEL_MARK)
        if mark and not mark.IsReadOnly:
            mark.Set('{template}'.format(n=n))
    t.Commit()

__result__ = len(elements)

name: Установить параметр всем элементам на уровне
description: Задать значение параметра всем элементам указанной категории на конкретном уровне
code_template:
import clr
clr.AddReference('RevitAPI')
from Autodesk.Revit.DB import *

collector = FilteredElementCollector(doc).OfCategory(BuiltInCategory.OST_{category}).WhereElementIsNotElementType()
elements = [e for e in collector if e.LookupParameter('Level') and e.LookupParameter('Level').AsValueString() == '{level}']

count = 0
with Transaction(doc, 'Set parameter') as t:
    t.Start()
    for elem in elements:
        p = elem.LookupParameter('{param_name}')

    t.Commit()

__result__ = count

name: Создать спецификацию по категории
description: Создать табличную спецификацию (ViewSchedule) для указанной категории с базовыми полями
code_template:
import clr
clr.AddReference('RevitAPI')
from Autodesk.Revit.DB import *

with Transaction(doc, 'Create schedule') as t:
    t.Start()
    schedule = ViewSchedule.CreateSchedule(doc, ElementId(BuiltInCategory.OST_{category}))
    schedule.Name = '{schedule_name}'
    
    # Add basic fields
    fields = schedule.Definition
    schedulable = fields.GetSchedulableFields()
    added = 0
    for sf in schedulable:
        if added >= 5:
            break
        try:
            fields.AddField(sf)
            added += 1
        except:
            pass
    
    t.Commit()

__result__ = schedule.Id.IntegerValue

name: Подсчитать площадь элементов по уровням
description: Посчитать суммарную площадь элементов категории на каждом уровне модели
code_template:
import clr
clr.AddReference('RevitAPI')
from Autodesk.Revit.DB import *

collector = FilteredElementCollector(doc).OfCategory(BuiltInCategory.OST_{category}).WhereElementIsNotElementType()

area_by_level = {}
for elem in collector:
    level_param = elem.LookupParameter('Level')
    level_name = level_param.AsValueString() if level_param else 'Без уровня'
    area_param = elem.get_Parameter(BuiltInParameter.HOST_AREA_COMPUTED)
    if area_param:
        area_m2 = area_param.AsDouble() * 0.092903  # sq ft to sq m
        area_by_level[level_name] = area_by_level.get(level_name, 0) + area_m2

# Round values
for k in area_by_level:
    area_by_level[k] = round(area_by_level[k], 2)

__result__ = area_by_level

name: Сводка по проекту
description: Собирает общую информацию по проекту: имя проекта, количество уровней, топ-5 категорий с количеством элементов
code_template:
import clr
clr.AddReference('RevitAPI')
from Autodesk.Revit.DB import *

# Имя проекта
info = doc.ProjectInformation
project_name = getattr(info, 'Name', '') or ''

# Уровни
levels = list(FilteredElementCollector(doc).OfClass(Level).ToElements())
level_count = len(levels)

# Все элементы по категориям
all_elements = list(FilteredElementCollector(doc).WhereElementIsNotElementType().ToElements())
category_counts = {}
for elem in all_elements:
    cat = elem.Category
    if cat is None:
        continue
    cat_name = cat.Name
    category_counts[cat_name] = category_counts.get(cat_name, 0) + 1

# Топ-5 категорий
sorted_cats = sorted(category_counts.items(), key=lambda x: x[1], reverse=True)
top5 = [{'category': k, 'count': v} for k, v in sorted_cats[:5]]

__result__ = {
    'project_name': project_name,
    'level_count': level_count,
    'total_elements': len(all_elements),
    'top_categories': top5
}

name: Помещения по этажам с площадями
description: Список помещений (Rooms), сгруппированных по уровню, с указанием площади в м²
code_template:
import clr
clr.AddReference('RevitAPI')
from Autodesk.Revit.DB import *
from Autodesk.Revit.DB.Architecture import Room

collector = list(FilteredElementCollector(doc).OfCategory(BuiltInCategory.OST_Rooms).WhereElementIsNotElementType().ToElements())

result = {}
for elem in collector:
    level_param = elem.LookupParameter('Level')
    level_name = level_param.AsValueString() if level_param else 'Без уровня'

    name_param = elem.LookupParameter('Name')
    room_name = name_param.AsString() if name_param else ''

    num_param = elem.LookupParameter('Number')
    room_num = num_param.AsString() if num_param else ''

    area_param = elem.get_Parameter(BuiltInParameter.ROOM_AREA)
    area_m2 = round(area_param.AsDouble() * 0.092903, 2) if area_param else 0.0

    if level_name not in result:
        result[level_name] = []
    result[level_name].append({
        'number': room_num,
        'name': room_name,
        'area_m2': area_m2
    })

__result__ = result

name: Спецификация дверей
description: Список всех дверей с маркой, уровнем, типом и размерами (ширина x высота)
code_template:
import clr
clr.AddReference('RevitAPI')
from Autodesk.Revit.DB import *

collector = list(FilteredElementCollector(doc).OfCategory(BuiltInCategory.OST_Doors).WhereElementIsNotElementType().ToElements())

result = []
for elem in collector:
    mark_param = elem.get_Parameter(BuiltInParameter.ALL_MODEL_MARK)
    mark = mark_param.AsString() if mark_param else ''

    level_param = elem.LookupParameter('Level')
    level = level_param.AsValueString() if level_param else ''

    elem_type = doc.GetElement(elem.GetTypeId())
    type_name = getattr(elem_type, 'Name', '') if elem_type else ''

    width_param = elem.get_Parameter(BuiltInParameter.DOOR_WIDTH)
    height_param = elem.get_Parameter(BuiltInParameter.DOOR_HEIGHT)
    width_mm = int(round(width_param.AsDouble() * 304.8)) if width_param else 0
    height_mm = int(round(height_param.AsDouble() * 304.8)) if height_param else 0
    size_str = '{0}x{1}'.format(width_mm, height_mm)

    result.append({
        'mark': mark,
        'level': level,
        'type': type_name,
        'size': size_str
    })

result.sort(key=lambda x: x['mark'])
__result__ = result

name: Стены по типам с суммарной длиной
description: Группировка стен по типу с подсчётом суммарной длины в метрах
code_template:
import clr
clr.AddReference('RevitAPI')
from Autodesk.Revit.DB import *

collector = list(FilteredElementCollector(doc).OfCategory(BuiltInCategory.OST_Walls).WhereElementIsNotElementType().ToElements())

result = {}
for elem in collector:
    elem_type = doc.GetElement(elem.GetTypeId())
    type_name = getattr(elem_type, 'Name', 'Unknown') if elem_type else 'Unknown'

    length_param = elem.get_Parameter(BuiltInParameter.CURVE_ELEM_LENGTH)
    length_m = length_param.AsDouble() * 0.3048 if length_param else 0.0

    if type_name not in result:
        result[type_name] = {'count': 0, 'total_length_m': 0.0}
    result[type_name]['count'] += 1
    result[type_name]['total_length_m'] += length_m

# Round
for k in result:
    result[k]['total_length_m'] = round(result[k]['total_length_m'], 2)

__result__ = result

name: Скопировать значение параметра A в параметр B
description: Для всех элементов указанной категории копирует значение из параметра source_param в параметр target_param
code_template:
import clr
clr.AddReference('RevitAPI')
from Autodesk.Revit.DB import *

category = '{category}'
source_param = '{source_param}'
target_param = '{target_param}'

collector = list(FilteredElementCollector(doc).OfCategory(getattr(BuiltInCategory, 'OST_' + category)).WhereElementIsNotElementType().ToElements())

count = 0
errors = []

with Transaction(doc, 'Copy parameter value') as t:
    t.Start()
    for elem in collector:
        src = elem.LookupParameter(source_param)
        dst = elem.LookupParameter(target_param)
        if src is None or dst is None or dst.IsReadOnly:
            continue
        try:
            if src.StorageType == StorageType.String:
                val = src.AsString() or ''
                dst.Set(val)
            elif src.StorageType == StorageType.Double:
                dst.Set(src.AsDouble())
            elif src.StorageType == StorageType.Integer:
                dst.Set(src.AsInteger())
            count += 1
        except Exception as ex:
            errors.append(str(ex))
    t.Commit()

__result__ = {'updated': count, 'errors': len(errors)}

description: Находит все экземпляры семейства с указанным именем и возвращает список с уровнем и маркой
code_template:
import clr
clr.AddReference('RevitAPI')
from Autodesk.Revit.DB import *

family_name = '{family_name}'

collector = list(FilteredElementCollector(doc).OfClass(FamilyInstance).ToElements())

result = []
for elem in collector:
    fam = elem.Symbol.Family if elem.Symbol else None
    if fam is None:
        continue
    fam_name = getattr(fam, 'Name', '')
    if fam_name != family_name:
        continue

    mark_param = elem.get_Parameter(BuiltInParameter.ALL_MODEL_MARK)
    mark = mark_param.AsString() if mark_param else ''

    level_param = elem.LookupParameter('Level')
    level = level_param.AsValueString() if level_param else ''

    sym_name = getattr(elem.Symbol, 'Name', '') if elem.Symbol else ''

    result.append({
        'id': elem.Id.IntegerValue,
        'type': sym_name,
        'level': level,
        'mark': mark
    })

__result__ = {'family': family_name, 'count': len(result), 'instances': result}

name: Спецификация структурных колонн
description: Список несущих колонн с типом сечения, уровнем и маркой
code_template:
import clr
clr.AddReference('RevitAPI')
from Autodesk.Revit.DB import *

collector = list(FilteredElementCollector(doc).OfCategory(BuiltInCategory.OST_StructuralColumns).WhereElementIsNotElementType().ToElements())

result = []
for elem in collector:
    mark_param = elem.get_Parameter(BuiltInParameter.ALL_MODEL_MARK)
    mark = mark_param.AsString() if mark_param else ''

    level_param = elem.LookupParameter('Base Level')
    if level_param is None:
        level_param = elem.LookupParameter('Level')
    level = level_param.AsValueString() if level_param else ''

    elem_type = doc.GetElement(elem.GetTypeId())
    type_name = getattr(elem_type, 'Name', '') if elem_type else ''

    # Сечение: ширина x высота (если есть)
    b_param = None
    h_param = None
    if elem_type:
        b_param = elem_type.LookupParameter('b')
        h_param = elem_type.LookupParameter('h')
        if b_param is None:
            b_param = elem_type.LookupParameter('Width')
        if h_param is None:
            h_param = elem_type.LookupParameter('Depth')

    b_mm = int(round(b_param.AsDouble() * 304.8)) if b_param else 0
    h_mm = int(round(h_param.AsDouble() * 304.8)) if h_param else 0
    section = '{0}x{1}'.format(b_mm, h_mm) if (b_mm and h_mm) else ''

    result.append({
        'mark': mark,
        'type': type_name,
        'section': section,
        'level': level
    })

result.sort(key=lambda x: x['mark'])
__result__ = {'count': len(result), 'columns': result}

name: Задать Comments всем элементам категории
description: Устанавливает параметр Comments для всех элементов указанной категории
code_template:
import clr
clr.AddReference('RevitAPI')
from Autodesk.Revit.DB import *

category = '{category}'
comment_value = '{comment_value}'

collector = list(FilteredElementCollector(doc).OfCategory(getattr(BuiltInCategory, 'OST_' + category)).WhereElementIsNotElementType().ToElements())

count = 0
skipped = 0

with Transaction(doc, 'Set bulk comment') as t:
    t.Start()
    for elem in collector:
        p = elem.get_Parameter(BuiltInParameter.ALL_MODEL_INSTANCE_COMMENTS)
        if p is None:
            p = elem.LookupParameter('Comments')
        if p and not p.IsReadOnly:
            p.Set(comment_value)
            count += 1
        else:
            skipped += 1
    t.Commit()

__result__ = {'updated': count, 'skipped': skipped, 'total': len(collector)}
